remarks: Discover the perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience in this beautiful 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath colonial home in the Spring Hill neighborhood of Norwalk on a quiet street. Offering 1,656 sq. ft. of thoughtfully updated living space on a spacious 0.21-acre lot, this home features soaring ceilings w/skylights in the living room w/ exposed beams, and a stylish interior. Updated kitchen offers granite counters and st/st appliances. Main level bathroom has laundry area as well. Upstairs, the primary suite offers privacy and comfort with an en-suite bath. 2 additional bedrooms and a second full bath complete the second floor. Enjoy added security with a built-in security system and energy savings on your electric bill from rooftop solar panels! Outdoor amenities include a fenced in backyard, basketball hoop, patio and a playground, making this home ideal for all ages! Complete with a one-car garage, this home is a must-see! Available immediately.
